headline: Executive order signed April 9, 2025, addresses federal rules on water pressure in showerheads.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with federal standards that affect how much water pressure showerheads provide. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it directs federal agencies to take are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy or use showerheads
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns rules that may affect the water pressure of showerheads sold in the US.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that make or sell showerheads
who_it_affects.how: The order may change the federal standards their products must meet.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 9, 2025; the timing of any resulting rule changes is not stated in the available information.
